public.description: Used to access information and interact with users.

methods.GetFriendList: Returns the friend list of a specified user. If the user's friend list is marked as private, returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
methods.GetPlayerBans: Returns ban status information for one or more players, including VAC bans, community bans, game bans, and economy bans.
methods.GetPlayerSummaries: Returns detailed profile information for one or more players, including username, profile URL, avatar, and game playtime.
methods.ResolveVanityURL: Resolves a custom Steam vanity URL to its corresponding SteamID. Supports individual profiles, groups, and official game groups.

public.description: Used to access user achievements and statistics for games.

methods.GetGlobalAchievementPercentagesForApp: Retrieves the global achievement percentages for the specified app across all players.
methods.GetNumberOfCurrentPlayers: Returns the total number of players currently active in the specified app on Steam.
methods.GetSchemaForGame: Returns the complete list of stats and achievements for the specified game, including localized names and descriptions.
methods.GetPlayerAchievements: Returns the list of achievements the specified user has unlocked in an app.
methods.GetUserStatsForGame: Returns the list of statistics that the specified user has set in an app.

public.description: Used to access data about applications on Steam.
Provides access to the Steam News functionality.
Used to access public information from the Steam Store.
Methods for reading Steam user reviews.
Provides miscellaneous Web API related functionality through utility methods.

methods.GetSupportedAPIList: Returns the list of all supported Steam Web API methods and their parameters. This is used to build the official Steamworks documentation.
methods.GetServerInfo: Returns basic information about the Steam API servers.

game_development.description: The primary interface to interact with the features/inventory/economy.
This is the interface used to interact with Game Notifications.
Methods to improve the administration of Steam Game Servers.
Interface to get and interact with game server stats.
This service allows your game to report cheats and cheaters to the features/anticheat#VAC system and provides the toolset behind the Game Bans system.
Steam Cloud API for use with cross-platform saves.

workshop_content.description: Primary interface for interacting with the Steam Workshop and User Generated Content (UGC).
Provides additional methods for interacting with Steam Workshop items.
Additional Steam Workshop service methods for publishers. See ISteamRemoteStorage to interact with Steam Workshop items directly.
Allows partners to globally search the content of their Steam Workshop.
Allows partners to access the voting information of the content in their Steam Workshop.
Provides methods for dealing with moderation of Steam Workshop items.

economy_trading.description: Additional Steam Economy methods that provide access to Steam Trading.
A secondary interface to interact with the features/inventory/economy.
Provides restricted access to the Steam Market for partners.
This is the interface used to access the Steam Inventory Service.

monetization.description: This is the interface used to support Microtransactions (In-Game Purchases).
Exposes the ISteamMicroTxn interface with a dummy database for development and testing purposes.

community_partner.description: Provides restricted access to Steam Community features.
Provides additional methods for interacting with Steam Users.
Used to access information about users.

specialized.description: This is the interface used to access the Steam Lobby Service.
Used to access information on financial reporting.
APIs for the Steam Site License program (commercial licenses for multi-user sites such as PC Cafes, VR Arcades, Universities, etc)
